theory_of_liability: Adopted mediation recommendation from Sala Ajaniku (ZERO verifiable credentials) without verification, reversing protective DVRO. The question is whether reliance on an unqualified mediator is a judicial act (immune) or an administrative failure (not immune).
immunity_analysis: Judicial immunity applies for acts in judicial capacity (Stump v. Sparkman, 435 U.S. 349 (1978)). However: (1) 1996 FRIA amendment permits injunctive/declaratory relief against judges under §1983; (2) Pulliam v. Allen, 466 U.S. 522 (1984) and progeny; (3) strategic recommendation: name for declaratory/injunctive relief only, focus damages on non-immune defendants.
strategic_note: Naming the judge is important for completeness of the conspiracy narrative and for injunctive relief (preventing future reliance on unqualified mediators), but damages recovery from this defendant is unlikely.
